Apple challenges UK government data access demand

Apple has filed a legal complaint against the UK Interior Ministry's demand for access to encrypted user data. The complaint was lodged last month at the Investigatory Powers Tribunal. This challenge follows a previous request by the Home Office for 'back door' access to encrypted iCloud data of British users, which the ministry had agreed to abandon a year prior.
